title: RC 串联电路中的相位差：谁超前、谁滞后
tags: 电容 VCR 相量形式
statement: u_s(t) = 20√2 cos(1000t) V，R = 10 Ω，C = 100 µF 串联。电流 i 与电容电压 u_C 的参考方向如图。
用有效值相量求电流 İ 的有效值和初相、u_C 的初相，并判断 u_s 与 i 的相位关系。

questions.ask: u_s 与 i 的相位关系是？（φ = ψ_u − ψ_i）
choiceExplain: 相减的顺序反了（算成 ψ_i − ψ_u）；φ 规定为 ψ_u − ψ_i，u_s 超前 i 是感性电路的情形。
只看了电容、忽略了 R，而且纯电容时是电压滞后电流 90°（φ = −90°），不是超前；有 R 时 |φ| = arctan(X_C/R) < 90°。
只有 X_C = 0（纯电阻）时才同相；同相的是 u_R 与 i，不是 u_s 与 i。
questions.explain: φ = ψ_u − ψ_i = 0° − 45° = −45° < 0，所以 u_s 滞后 i 45°，即 i 超前 u_s 45°——容性电路的电流超前电压。注意：只有同频率的正弦量才谈得上相位差。

hints: 以 U̇_s = 20∠0° V 为参考相量，先求 X_C = 1/(ωC)。
串联电路的电流 İ = U̇_s/(R − jX_C)，各元件电压再按元件的相量关系求。
相位差 φ = ψ_u − ψ_i：φ > 0 电压超前，φ < 0 电压滞后。
solution: **4. 相位差。** φ = ψ_u − ψ_i = −45°：**i 超前 u_s 45°**。另外 u_R 超前 u_C 90°，相量图上 U̇_R ⊥ U̇_C，合成 U̇_s = U̇_R + U̇_C，模 √(14.14² + 14.14²) = 20 V，验算正确。

en.title: Phase difference in a series RC circuit: which leads, which lags
statement: u_s(t) = 20√2 cos(1000t) V drives R = 10 Ω in series with C = 100 µF. The reference directions of the current i and the capacitor voltage u_C are shown.
Using rms phasors, find the rms value and initial phase of the current phasor İ, the initial phase of u_C, and decide how u_s and i are related in phase.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the current, ψ_i = ?

questions.explain: U̇_C = −jX_C·İ = 10∠−90° × √2∠45° = 10√2∠−45° V: the capacitor voltage lags its current by 90°.

questions.ask: How are u_s and i related in phase? (φ = ψ_u − ψ_i)
choiceExplain: The subtraction is reversed (ψ_i − ψ_u); φ is defined as ψ_u − ψ_i, and u_s leading i would be an inductive circuit.
This ignores R, and even for a pure capacitor the voltage lags the current by 90° (φ = −90°) rather than leading; with R present |φ| = arctan(X_C/R) < 90°.
Only a purely resistive circuit (X_C = 0) is in phase; it is u_R, not u_s, that is in phase with i.
questions.explain: φ = ψ_u − ψ_i = 0° − 45° = −45° < 0, so u_s lags i by 45°, i.e. i leads u_s by 45° — in a capacitive circuit the current leads the voltage. Note that a phase difference is only meaningful between sinusoids of the same frequency.

hints: Take U̇_s = 20∠0° V as the reference phasor and first compute X_C = 1/(ωC).
The series current is İ = U̇_s/(R − jX_C); each element voltage follows from its own phasor relation.
Phase difference φ = ψ_u − ψ_i: φ > 0 means the voltage leads, φ < 0 means it lags.
solution: **3. Element voltages.** U̇_R = 10√2∠45° V (in phase with İ), U̇_C = −j10 × √2∠45° = 10√2∠**−45°** V (90° behind İ).

**4. Phase difference.** φ = ψ_u − ψ_i = −45°: **i leads u_s by 45°**. Also u_R leads u_C by 90°; in the phasor diagram U̇_R ⊥ U̇_C and U̇_s = U̇_R + U̇_C has magnitude √(14.14² + 14.14²) = 20 V, which checks.
